Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Professional Summary
Senior front-end developer focused on building scalable Angular applications with strong TypeScript practices, automated unit testing, and collaborative delivery using Jira and Confluence. Proven track record delivering feature-rich interfaces for e-commerce and healthcare domains, improving test coverage and frontend performance. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Jest, Linux, Confluence, Jira

Work Experience
Senior Angular Developer, CartNest (Nov 2019 - Present)
- Led development of a reusable Angular component library for CartNest checkout and product catalog, using Angular and TypeScript; components reduced duplication across apps by 45% and improved load times.
- Implemented Jest-based unit testing strategy and increased frontend test coverage from under 25% to over 70% for core modules, catching regressions before release.
- Optimized bundle sizes and runtime performance on Linux CI pipelines, leveraging lazy loading and TypeScript compiler optimizations to reduce initial load by 30%.
- Coordinated releases and documentation in Confluence and managed sprint tasks and bug triage in Jira to maintain predictable delivery cadence.

Angular Developer, Orbit Health (Nov 2016 - Oct 2019)
- Built patient-facing dashboards and appointment booking flows using Angular, HTML and CSS, improving appointment conversion rates through UX refinements.
- Wrote and maintained Jest unit tests for critical components, raising component test coverage and reducing post-release defects.
- Collaborated with backend and QA teams via Jira and Confluence to define requirements, triage issues, and track feature rollout.
- Deployed and validated builds on Linux-based environments and assisted in migrating legacy templates to modern Angular patterns.

Education
B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
